summary: 5 steps: 3 auto (applied as diffs you approve), 2 manual.

steps.title: Swap base image in Dockerfile
steps.detail: Replaces the NVIDIA image reference on the FROM line (line 1) with target.rocm_image from portcheck.yaml, keeping any 'AS <name>' suffix.

steps.title: Remove NVIDIA pip pins in requirements.txt
steps.detail: Deletes nvidia-* requirement lines and replaces any download.pytorch.org/whl/cu<N> URL with target.torch_index_url from portcheck.yaml (line 3).

steps.title: Guard NVML use in gpu_stats.py
steps.detail: Wraps the top-level 'import pynvml' (line 3) in try/except ImportError so that pynvml is None on machines without NVML. This fix covers the import only. Lines 10, 12, 13, 15 call 'pynvml.'; each call site needs a manual 'if pynvml is not None' check.

steps.title: Port custom CUDA source in ext/fast_op.cu
steps.detail: Manual work: Port this CUDA source by hand. Evaluate HIPIFY (AMD's CUDA-to-HIP translator) and SCALE (a toolchain that compiles CUDA for AMD GPUs) as starting points, then rebuild and test on the AMD machine. portcheck does not translate kernels.

steps.title: Replace TensorRT use in trt_backend.py
steps.detail: Manual work (line 3): TensorRT runs only on NVIDIA GPUs. A person must replace this code path with one that works on ROCm, for example plain PyTorch, ONNX Runtime with the MIGraphX or ROCm provider, or MIGraphX directly, and re-validate the outputs.
